title: SWOT Analysis of Home-Based Learning during COVID-19 from Pre-University Students’ Perspectives - All Responses
descriptions: The dataset refers to all responses obtained from a questionnaire used in a study to evaluate students' perceived strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats from their experience undergoing home-based online learning in Malaysia.
